title: Personal Amiga, Kult, CPC and SC-3000 discovery pass
summary: Personally screen 94 search hits, inspect nine new roots, add six source-backed projects and defer three candidates.
notes: Root performed all research and publication directly; no discovery worker. Four fresh repository searches were screened locally against current main before primary-source review. Unrelated SC3000 substring matches were discarded during triage, not described as investigated projects. Nine selected roots were inspected with immutable trees and blob-verified inline source proofs. This is a bounded pass, not exhaustive platform coverage. Distinguish matching originals from patched outputs, source cores from runnable ports, hardware/binary releases from source-backed software, and claimed completion from actual code. No upstream code was executed and no private inputs were downloaded.

sources.reason: Original main, loader and two boot sources have byte-comparison build gates; a separate enhanced path replaces disk routines and boot chain to build an AmigaDOS-format disk. Extracted graphics/music and tools are included. Keep original-byte matching distinct from the deliberately modified enhanced build.

Assembly reconstruction of the original Atari ST engine with transcribed tables, Alcyon C startup/music and relocation reconstruction. Concrete assembly and build scripts are present; not merely a decompilation goal.

Substantive Caprice32 4.1.0 adaptation with joystick-driven virtual keyboard, four-controller/ToTo support, autorun, snapshots and Pi-specific display handling. Includes emulator core and source build files rather than only a packaged binary.
Original 2021 CPC game by Angelos Mavros. The substantial readable BASIC listing contains title flow, character drawing, dialogue and game interaction, accompanied by tape/audio distribution files.
Pico-hosted SC-3000 emulator implements RAM, TMS9918 video, PSG, cartridge/tape handling and keyboard/gamepad input. CMake lists actual machine, Z80, VGA, filesystem and USB implementation units.
Reusable Z80 routines detect keyboard/PPI availability and merge cursor/key rows with joystick inputs; companion startup, interrupt and VDP/PSG templates support native game development.

Defer claimed complete Menace port: README and COMPLETED claims conflict with unfinished original logic; actual game.cpp uses generic timed random enemies and placeholder rendering, while disassembly helper slices guessed disk offsets. Concrete tools exist, but faithful reconstruction and reliable extraction claims are not established. Do not promote completion rhetoric as game restoration.

Defer execution-architecture review, not the separate matching ASM project. C core explicitly is not playable and retains a flat 68000 address-space image, machine-width arithmetic and boundary register parameters. Musashi is the reference oracle, which alone is not baked-emulation evidence; determine the deployed core runtime boundary before a native-port or baked-emulation classification.

Defer software inclusion: this root provides PCB/enclosure design, documentation and compiled STM32 update/bootloader binaries, but no corresponding firmware source tree. Do not describe hardware manufacturing files plus binaries as a source-backed software implementation.
